\ubblockdescription{detection.fluss}{EXPERIMENTAL: on real recordings it found nothing beyond its surrogate null (docs/prompts/blocks/reports/W1-evaluation.md). Where does the recording change behaviour? For every window the matrix profile finds its most similar window elsewhere; inside one regime those look-alikes stay inside it, so at a change few of the links cross. The score is high where few cross (1 \ensuremath{-} CAC; 0 = no change). Detrend first: a drifting baseline makes every window look alike and the score goes flat (no change found). Set `window\_s` to about one event period (the paper's rule) and tune it first. Follow with Threshold to get one span per change; the cut depends on the window --- a longer window raises the peaks --- so recalibrate the cut whenever you change `window\_s` (the fluss\_regimes template's 0.46 is for 300 s). Windows touching NaN are not scored (the rolling-mean detrend keeps a gap to its own length), so check the recording's NaN gaps before trusting a span beside one. Costs a full matrix profile (O(n\ensuremath{^2})).}
